description: A torrent of water bursts from a stone-arched tunnel mouth in a red rock face and tears down a collapsing hillside. Below, bearded men in brown tunics and bare legs work with long-handled rakes and shovels in shallow muddy channels, while timber sluice boxes carry the brown slurry. Stormy grey sky, dust and spray. No visible text or frame; a tiny coloured mark sits in the bottom-right corner.
